note: Layout-pattern library distilled from a full visual pass over all 158 long-template slides (Session 2b). These are STRUCTURAL archetypes — how Kumulus arranges dense information with boxes, bars, columns, and diagrams — independent of semantic meaning (the long template's content is placeholder '[x]'). Use this as the 'idea box' when choosing how to lay out a slide; pair with routing/taxonomy.json (what the slide means) and the real-IM canon (how Kumulus writes it). Exemplars are long-template slide numbers (see atlas/thumbs/ltp/NNN.png).

LP-COVER.name: Cover
LP-COVER.recipe: Deal codename + 'Information Memorandum' + month/year, Kumulus mark, confidentiality; optional orange contact chip.

LP-TOC.name: Table of contents
LP-TOC.recipe: Numbered section rows with page tabs on the right.

LP-NOTICE.name: Important notice / disclaimer
LP-NOTICE.recipe: Dense full-width running text, small type, optional adviser contact block.

LP-DIVIDER.name: Section divider
LP-DIVIDER.recipe: Oversized ghosted section number/letter + section title, minimal chrome; footer tab expands to the new section.

LP-COL-HEADERBAR.name: Columns under header bars
LP-COL-HEADERBAR.recipe: 2-4 columns, each capped by a navy header bar (white end-knobs), content (bullets/charts/rows) beneath; optional right rail.

LP-COL-PLAIN.name: Columns under small-caps headings
LP-COL-PLAIN.recipe: 3-4 columns headed by small-caps + black title-rule; square-bullet copy; evidence row at bottom.

LP-CARD-GRID.name: Card / box grid
LP-CARD-GRID.recipe: Grid of equal boxes (2x2 up to 4x2), each an icon/heading/short body; flat hairline cards, footer bar.

LP-KPI-COMBO.name: KPI tiles + combo chart
LP-KPI-COMBO.recipe: Left KPI tile grid (2x3) + icon bullets; right a stacked-bar + EBITDA%-line combo with CAGR callouts over a donut panel on a grey band. The signature 'at a glance' construction.

LP-KPI-STRIP.name: KPI strip
LP-KPI-STRIP.recipe: Full-width row of large KPI figures (label + value + period), optional navy band, supporting row beneath.

LP-CHART-COMMENTARY.name: Chart + commentary
LP-CHART-COMMENTARY.recipe: One dominant chart (bar/line/area) with a bulleted commentary rail; period tags; footnote source.

LP-CHART-DASHBOARD.name: Chart dashboard
LP-CHART-DASHBOARD.recipe: Grid of 3-4 small charts (mini-lines/columns/donuts) + a gauge/legend; scorecard feel.

LP-WATERFALL.name: Waterfall / bridge
LP-WATERFALL.recipe: Waterfall or bridge columns (start -> deltas -> end) with connectors and labels; commentary boxes or process footer.

LP-DONUT-ROW.name: Donut row
LP-DONUT-ROW.recipe: Row of donuts (splits/shares) with center labels + legend; often over a KPI strip / navy band.

LP-COLUMN-TREND.name: Column chart with trend callouts
LP-COLUMN-TREND.recipe: Grouped/stacked columns with CAGR brackets and trend line; period tags FYxxA/E.

LP-DATA-TABLE.name: Dense data table
LP-DATA-TABLE.recipe: Financial/KPI table: row labels + period columns; navy header row; totals/adjustment rows; small type OK.

LP-MATRIX-CHECK.name: Capability matrix (harvey balls)
LP-MATRIX-CHECK.recipe: Rows (companies/criteria) x columns (dimensions) filled with harvey-ball / dot ratings; header bars per column group.

LP-GANTT.name: Gantt / roadmap table
LP-GANTT.recipe: Row labels + horizontal phase bars across a time axis; milestone markers.

LP-COMPARE-TABLE.name: Comparison / feature matrix
LP-COMPARE-TABLE.recipe: Feature rows x option columns; icon rail; checks/values per cell; positioning takeaway.

LP-FIELD-DESC-IMPACT.name: Field / description / impact
LP-FIELD-DESC-IMPACT.recipe: Left vertical navy tab; rows of [field | description | impact-dot]; the recurring qualitative-assessment table.

LP-TIMELINE-H.name: Horizontal timeline
LP-TIMELINE-H.recipe: Single time axis with milestone nodes above/below; dated callouts; optional dual-sided (icons above and below).

LP-PROCESS-CHEVRON.name: Chevron process
LP-PROCESS-CHEVRON.recipe: Row of chevron/arrow steps (navy) left-to-right; content per step beneath; capability bar footer.

LP-PROCESS-MAP.name: Process / flow map
LP-PROCESS-MAP.recipe: Boxes connected by arrows across the canvas (linear or branching); picture/label boxes; may include a rail.

LP-STAIRCASE.name: Ascending staircase
LP-STAIRCASE.recipe: Stepped ascending blocks (growth/maturity), each a labelled stage; node diagram beside.

LP-STAGEGATE.name: Stage-gate lists
LP-STAGEGATE.recipe: Sequential stages, each a numbered vertical list of items; gate markers between.

LP-PYRAMID.name: Pyramid / segmentation
LP-PYRAMID.recipe: Layered pyramid (market/segment tiers) as hero, columns of detail beneath or beside.

LP-FUNNEL.name: Funnel / cone
LP-FUNNEL.recipe: Vertical funnel/cone narrowing through stages; counts per stage; panels/table beside (pipeline, M&A funnel).

LP-FLYWHEEL.name: Flywheel / circular cycle
LP-FLYWHEEL.recipe: Circular ring of segments/arrows (repeating cycle) with center label; numbered rail beside.

LP-HUB.name: Hub and spoke
LP-HUB.recipe: Central node with radiating connectors to satellites; right rail of icons/labels (ecosystem, one-stop-shop).

LP-VENN.name: Venn / overlapping circles
LP-VENN.recipe: 3 overlapping circles (intersection = positioning); text rail; optional node path.

LP-MATRIX-2X2.name: 2x2 positioning matrix
LP-MATRIX-2X2.recipe: Two labelled axes forming quadrants; players plotted; company profile table beside.

LP-ISOMETRIC.name: Isometric layers
LP-ISOMETRIC.recipe: Stacked 3D platform layers (architecture/maturity); labels per layer.

LP-ORG-TREE.name: Org / ownership / hierarchy tree
LP-ORG-TREE.recipe: Top-down box hierarchy with % or roles on connectors (org chart, ownership tree, network).

LP-PERSPECTIVE.name: Perspective panels
LP-PERSPECTIVE.recipe: Trapezoid / receding panels implying progression or depth; icons within; muted end panel.

LP-TRIANGLE.name: Triangle (3-part)
LP-TRIANGLE.recipe: Triangle split into 3 labelled parts (or 3 play-triangles) + list panels.

LP-HERO-ARC.name: Investment-highlights arc
LP-HERO-ARC.recipe: Curved connector / arc with numbered nodes fanning to text rows; 'central idea -> N highlights'.

LP-PHOTO-LIST.name: Photo + numbered list
LP-PHOTO-LIST.recipe: Full-height photo one side; numbered narrative rows the other; curved separator.

LP-NUMBERED-RIGHT.name: Content + big numbers
LP-NUMBERED-RIGHT.recipe: Icon matrix / content left; oversized 1/2/3 markers with headlines right.

LP-GEO-MAP.name: Geographic map + data
LP-GEO-MAP.recipe: Belgium/Europe choropleth or pin map + data table/legend + icon row; expansion sequence uses several maps.

LP-SCREENS.name: Product / screen mockups
LP-SCREENS.recipe: Device or app-screen mockups (monitor, phone, cards) with process boxes; product/IT demonstration.

LP-CONTEXT-APPROACH-RESULT.name: Case study (Context / Approach / Result)
LP-CONTEXT-APPROACH-RESULT.recipe: Three chevron-ended header bars (CONTEXT -> APPROACH -> RESULT) each over a content column; warm-band optional; client quote/KPIs.
